test_name: Verify Navigation to Product Categories from Cart Page
description: This test ensures users can navigate to product categories from the cart page using category links.
steps: Navigate to the cart page at https://atid.store/cart-2/.
Click on the 'MEN' category link in the navigation menu.
Verify that the 'Men' product category page loads successfully.
Click on the 'WOMEN' category link in the navigation menu.
Verify that the 'Women' product category page loads successfully.
expected_results: User successfully navigates to the 'Men' product category page.
User successfully navigates to the 'Women' product category page.
edge_cases: Category links do not redirect to the correct pages.
Navigation menu fails to load due to a server error.
Product category pages fail to load.
One or more category links are disabled due to permissions.
User encounters a network timeout while accessing category pages.
data_requirements: Product category pages must exist and be accessible.
Category links must be correctly routed.
Navigation menu must be visible on the cart page.
Cart page must allow navigation to other sections.
dependencies: Product category pages must be configured properly.
Navigation menu must be implemented correctly.
api_interactions: GET request for navigation menu data.
GET request for product category page data.
performance_metrics: Page load time for product category pages.
accessibility_requirements: Category links should have descriptive ARIA labels.
Navigation menu should be keyboard accessible.
Product category pages should have appropriate semantic HTML.
